name: Broccoli

schedule.notes: Bury stem up to first true leaves. Tolerates light frost.
Nitrogen-heavy at this stage; heads form best with steady N.
Fall crop is often the better one — heat-stress is the main enemy in spring.
Cut the main head while buds are tight; side shoots keep coming for weeks.

harvest.cues: Head is firm, buds tight and unopened. If you see yellow flowers, harvest immediately.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge 5 to 7 days. Blanch 3 minutes and freeze for longer.

varieties.name: Calabrese
varieties.notes: Strong side-shoot production after main cut.

varieties.name: Waltham 29
varieties.notes: Bred for fall planting and cold tolerance.

notes: Heat above 80 F triggers premature flowering ('buttoning'). Mulch heavily and shade in late spring. Floating row covers stop cabbage moths.
